s: Nebuchadnezzar defeats Arphaxad, king of the Medes.
Nebuchadnezzar sends his general Holofernes to conquer the western nations.
The nations submit to Holofernes, who destroys their gods.
Israel prepares to resist and cries out to the Lord.
Achior the Ammonite warns Holofernes that Israel cannot be defeated unless it sins against its God.
Holofernes hands Achior over to the Israelites.
Holofernes besieges Bethulia and cuts off its water. The leaders promise to surrender in five days.
Judith, a devout and wise widow, rebukes the leaders for testing God and says she will act.
Judith prays to the Lord for strength.
Judith dresses in her finest clothes and goes to the enemy camp.
Judith wins the trust of Holofernes.
Judith stays in the camp, keeping the law and praying each night.
At a banquet Holofernes falls into a drunken sleep and Judith cuts off his head, then returns to Bethulia.
Holofernes's head is shown to the people, and Achior believes in God.
The Assyrian army flees in panic and Israel plunders the camp.
Judith's song of praise. She lives honoured to old age.
